column2: Retain the seventh year, Jehoiada's strengthening, five commanders with their patronymics, and taking them into a house. The selected destination is not changed to into a covenant to match another version.
column3: The unspecified house and exact force of strengthening remain provisional.

column2: Retain circuit through Judah, Levites from all its cities, Israel's ancestral rulers and arrival in Jerusalem. The ancestral rulers are not confined to Judah by a substituted ethnonym.
Retain the whole Judah assembly's covenant with the king in God's house, showing the king's son and the command that he reign according to the promise about David's house.
column3: The unexpressed singular shower/speaker is contextually Jehoiada; the covenant's reference to the king before the presentation remains as transmitted.

column2: Retain the first third, priests and Levites, Sabbath entrance and entrance gates. No detailed guard shift is invented to explain the elliptical assignment.
column3: At the gates represents the destination phrase; the connection of entry and stationing remains open.

column2: Retain the remaining thirds at the king's house and Middle Gate and all people in the Lord's courtyards. Middle Gate is not replaced with a different gate name from Kings.

Retain priests, Levites and ministering Levites as expressed, permission grounded in holiness and the people's keeping the Lord's charges. Do not delete the repeated Levites category as an apparent duplication.

Retain Levites encircling the king, each weapon in hand, death for entering the house and accompaniment in both directions. The prohibited entry is read within verse 6's exceptions rather than expanded with an invented exception list.

Retain full obedience, each man's company, beginning and ending of Sabbath and Jehoiada's not dismissing the divisions. The selected time wording is not silently converted to two incoming/outgoing groups.
column3: The Sabbath construction and its institutional setting require further review.

column2: Retain swords, large shields and weapons belonging to David in God's house. No commanders as recipients are inserted where the selected clause leaves them unexpressed.
Retain individual weapons and the spatial span from the right side of the house to the left side of altar and house around the king. Do not regularize the architecture from a presumed temple plan.
column3: The exact attachment of altar and house in the spatial description remains unresolved.

column2: Retain crown and plural testimonies placed upon the son, followed by Jehoiada and his sons making and anointing him king and the acclamation. Testimonies is not silently converted to a single physical scroll.
column3: The physical meaning of testimonies and its placement remain open.

column2: Retain the sound of runners, thanksgiving and praise of the king and Athaliah entering toward the king. The object king is not replaced with God to normalize the praise language.

Retain the king's station, entrance, rulers, trumpets, rejoicing and instrumental singers, followed by torn robe and the doubled attacking expression. Do not replace the cry with an unqualified technical Treason.
column3: The participle plus finite form in the cry may carry a different force from two indicative statements; inherited repetition remains provisional.

column2: Retain Jehoiada's exit and repeated identification, orders to commanders and army leaders, expulsion outside, going in after her and death by sword outside the Lord's house. No command to kill all followers is imported.
column3: The direction go in after her remains a selected-text difficulty and is not resolved by reversing it.

column2: Retain room given to Athaliah, passage through the Horsemen's Gate of the royal house and death there. Giving room is not converted into seizing her hands from another text.
Retain the covenant between Jehoiada himself, people and king to be the Lord's people. The first party is not silently changed from himself to the Lord.
Retain all the land's people, demolition of Baal's house, grinding altars and idols, and killing Matthan before the altars. The violent actions remain explicit.

Retain work entrusted through priests and Levites, their restored divisions as David arranged, burnt offerings according to Moses and rejoicing and songs under David's direction. Neither organizing figure displaces the other.
Retain gatekeepers standing, the gates of the Lord's house and future exclusion of anyone unclean in any respect. The final phrase specifies uncleanness rather than a new task assignment.

Retain ancestral rulers, mighty men, other rulers and all people, bringing the king up into the Lord's house, entry through the Inner Gate into his house and seating him on the throne. The selected into the Lord's house is not changed to from it.
column3: The procession route and implicit singular entrant remain provisional contextual readings.

column2: Retain rejoicing, the city's quiet and the reiterated death of Athaliah by sword. The English pluperfect treats the final clause as a recap rather than an additional killing.
Retain Joash's accession at seven, forty-year reign in Jerusalem and Sabia from Beersabee. No maternal patronymic is added.
Retain doing right throughout Jehoiada's days. The temporal qualification prepares for the later change and is not broadened to Joash's entire life.
Retain Jehoiada taking two wives for him and the following unnamed begetter of sons and daughters. The contextual reading is Joash without adding an expressed name.
column3: The indirect object and implicit subject permit a referential question; the verb alone supplies no gender distinction.

column2: Retain the subsequent desire arising in Joash's heart to repair the Lord's house. The heart image describes intention without supplying a divine command.

Retain priests and Levites sent to Judah's cities, silver from all Israel, year-by-year strengthening and hurry to speak, followed by the Levites' failure to hurry. Speak is present in the selected wording and is not simply deleted.
column3: Hurry to speak remains a provisional source-close expression whose practical force is unresolved.

column2: Retain Joash's question to Jehoiada the ruler about oversight of the collection, Moses as man of God and assembling Israel for the Tent of Testimony. No fixed tax amount is invented.
Retain Athaliah as lawless, her sons' demolition and holy objects used for the Baalim. Do not eliminate the sons because of other royal-death notices.
Retain the command for a collection box outside at the Lord's gate. The box's function is contextual and no hole in its lid is imported.
Retain public proclamation in Judah and Jerusalem, bringing to the Lord and Moses as God's servant directing Israel in the wilderness. The quoted royal command continues from verse 8.
Retain all rulers and people giving and the repeated bringing and depositing until fullness. Contributions supplies an unexpressed contextual object without assigning a new amount.
Retain Levites transporting the box, royal overseers, increased silver, king's scribe and high priest's overseer emptying and replacing it, day after day. Both administrative offices remain distinct.
Retain king and priest jointly providing funds, workers hiring stonecutters, carpenters and iron/bronze smiths, and repeated repair of the Lord's house. The second repair phrase is not discarded.
Retain work increasing in extent through their hands, setting the house at its standing place and strengthening it. Do not infer a new expansion beyond the repair context merely from length/extent.
column3: The work-image and standing-place expression remain provisional calques requiring specialist and spoken-language review.

column2: Retain surplus silver returned, service articles for burnt offerings, gold and silver incense vessels, and continual offerings throughout Jehoiada's life. The vessel identification is not made a separate cult ritual assertion.
column3: The precise form and function of the incense vessels remain provisional.

column2: Retain old age, fullness of days and the explicit age of 130 at death. Do not shorten the number for historical plausibility.
Retain burial with kings and the threefold good toward Israel, God and His house. A priest's royal burial is expressly narrated and not a mistaken royal title.
Retain rulers bowing to the king after Jehoiada's death and the king then listening. Bowed down represents royal homage without silently identifying it as divine worship.

Retain abandoning the Lord, service to plural Astartes and idols, and wrath upon Judah and Jerusalem on that day. Do not replace the deities with groves or add an unexpressed explicit divine possessor to wrath.
Retain the sending of prophets to turn them back, testimony and both refusals to listen. The unnamed sender is contextually God; the repeated refusal is deliberate.

Retain God's Spirit clothing Azarias, his priestly title and Jehoiada parentage, elevated position, transgression question and forsaking response. Do not change Azarias to Zacharias to match another textual tradition.
Retain attack and stoning specifically at Joash's command in the Lord's courtyard. The king's responsibility is explicit rather than a later inference.

Retain Joash's failure to remember mercy, Jehoiada as the victim's father, the killing of his son and the dying appeal that the Lord see and judge. Victim's is a contextual clarification of the pronoun, not an extra Greek noun.

Retain after the year's completion, Syrian invasion of Judah and Jerusalem, all rulers destroyed among the people, and all spoils sent to Damascus's king. Do not identify the campaign as a particular season without evidence.
Retain few Syrian men, God's delivery of a very great force because of abandonment, and singular execution of judgments against Joash. He follows the explicit God in the preceding clause.
column3: The final unexpressed singular subject could require reconsideration alongside the collective army; capitalization records an interpretation, not a morphological gender signal.

column2: Retain grave illnesses, servants attacking because of the blood of Jehoiada's singular son, death on the bed, repeated death statement and nonroyal burial. Plural bloods does not justify changing the singular son to multiple sons.
Retain Zabed/Samath and Jozabed/Somaroth with Ammonite and Moabite labels. The Greek labels are masculine; do not convert the named parents into explicitly ethnic mothers to match another version.
column3: The attachment of each ethnonym within the patronymic chain remains open.

column2: Retain all his sons, the unexplained five approaching him, the remaining matters in the writing of kings and Amaziah's succession. Do not replace five with oracles or add a temple-repair clause absent from the selected verse.
column3: Whose sons, the identity of the five and whether came against overstates the approach verb remain unresolved in the inherited reading.
